name: Zadok
description: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Zadok and all the Levites bare the ark of the covenant, and David told Zadok to carry it back into the city, saying if he found favour in the eyes of the Most High, he would be brought again to see it and its habitation; but if not, let the Most High do as seemed good. He also told Zadok the seer to return with his son Ahimaaz and Jonathan the son of Abiathar, and to send him word. So they carried the ark again to Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Samuel 15: Absalom Steals the Hearts of Israel

points: David sent to Zadok and Abiathar the priests to speak to the elders of Judah, asking why they were the last to bring the king back when they were his brethren, his bone and his flesh. He told Amasa that he would make him captain of the host in the room of Joab.

note.label: 2 Samuel 19: The King Returns to His House

points: David commands that Solomon be set on the king's own mule and brought to Gihon, where Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. The people come up rejoicing so that the earth rings with the sound.

note.label: 1 Kings 1: A King Exalts Himself and a King Is Anointed

points: He called for the priests Zadok and Abiathar and for the Levites, showing the Most High had set a clear structure among the priesthood.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 15: None Ought to Carry the Ark but the Levites

points: Hezekiah questions the priests about the heaps, and Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answers that since the people began bringing offerings they have had enough to eat with plenty left, for the Lord has blessed his people.

Outside the inner gates are the chambers of the singers in the inner court. The chamber facing south is for the priests who keep the charge of the house, and the chamber facing north is for the priests who keep the charge of the altar, the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, who come near the Lord to minister.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: A holy oblation is set apart, with the sanctuary in the midst of it, for the priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge and went not astray when the children of Israel and the Levites went astray.

note.label: Ezekiel 48: The Land Divided and the Gates of the Tribes
